#### Clase `RichRenderable` (Línea 4)
- **Docstring:** _An abstract base class for Rich renderables.

Note that there is no need to extend this class, the intended use is to check if an
object supports the Rich renderable protocol. For example::

    if isinstance(my_object, RichRenderable):
        console.print(my_object)_
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __subclasshook__(cls, other)` (Línea 16): Check if this class supports the rich render protocol.
